title: Ship Feature
description: Take a feature request from unclear intent to implemented, verified, reviewable code.

steps.title: Scope
steps.goal: Clarify behavior, non-goals, and smallest useful version.

steps.title: Inspect
steps.goal: Find entry points, boundaries, and test seams.

steps.title: Implement
steps.goal: Use red-green-refactor to make the behavior real.

steps.title: Review
steps.goal: Catch regressions, edge cases, and test gaps.

steps.title: Hand Off
steps.goal: Summarize changes, verification, and risks.

title: Debug Regression
description: Find and fix a regression with a clear root cause and durable verification.

steps.title: Reproduce
steps.goal: Capture and minimize the failure.

steps.title: Prove
steps.goal: Add a regression signal when a good seam exists.

steps.title: Fix
steps.goal: Patch the root cause and remove debug instrumentation.

steps.title: Review
steps.goal: Check edge cases, callers, and test coverage.

steps.title: Hand Off
steps.goal: State root cause, fix, and verification commands.

title: Review PR
description: Review a diff for correctness, regressions, test gaps, and maintainability risks.

steps.title: Understand Intent
steps.goal: Identify the expected behavior change.

steps.title: Inspect Diff
steps.goal: Trace changed paths and report findings first.

steps.title: Check Boundaries
steps.goal: Review architecture only when shared design changes.

title: Obsidian Vault Cleanup
description: Organize an Obsidian vault or folder while preserving links and conventions.

steps.title: Discover
steps.goal: Find vault conventions before changing notes.

steps.title: Edit Notes
steps.goal: Normalize metadata, links, and tags.

steps.title: Map
steps.goal: Create a canvas when visual structure helps.

title: Create New Skill
description: Turn a repeated task into a clean, installable skill.

steps.title: Define Job
steps.goal: Clarify trigger, task, and boundaries.

steps.title: Research Patterns
steps.goal: Compare real skill repositories and reusable workflow conventions when useful.

steps.title: Create Skill
steps.goal: Write focused SKILL.md metadata and workflow.

steps.title: Hand Off
steps.goal: Explain usage and trigger examples.

title: Research Report
description: Research a current topic, repository pattern, or project context and produce a sourced Markdown report.

steps.title: Scope
steps.goal: Identify topic, audience, time window, source requirements, and output language.

steps.title: Gather
steps.goal: Collect current sources, official docs, local files, or repo examples.

steps.title: Write
steps.goal: Synthesize findings into a clean Markdown deliverable.

steps.title: Hand Off
steps.goal: Summarize sources, uncertainty, and next steps.

title: Build MCP Tool
description: Turn a repeated executable action into a clean MCP tool and connect it to skills and workflows.

steps.title: Classify
steps.goal: Decide whether the request belongs in a skill, workflow, or tool.

steps.title: Define Contract
steps.goal: Specify inputs, output shape, errors, and safety constraints.

steps.title: Implement
steps.goal: Build a narrow executable action and connect it to the registry.

steps.title: Review
steps.goal: Check failure behavior, unsafe inputs, and missing tests.

steps.title: Hand Off
steps.goal: Summarize contract, files changed, and verification.

title: Daily Personal Agent
description: Turn calendar, inbox, chat, notes, finance watch context, and memory into a clear personal daily plan.

steps.title: Scope Day
steps.goal: Identify date, priorities, and personal/work split.

steps.title: Gather Context
steps.goal: Inspect calendar, inbox, chat, notes, memory, and optional finance context.

steps.title: Plan
steps.goal: Create today's plan, action list, meeting prep, and drafts.

steps.title: Hand Off
steps.goal: Mark drafts, open loops, and user-run actions.

title: Personal Knowledge Sync
description: Move knowledge between Obsidian, Notion, local memory, and optional RAG indexes safely.

steps.title: Choose Source
steps.goal: Decide which system is source of truth for this sync.

steps.title: Inspect
steps.goal: Read selected notes/pages and related memories.

steps.title: Plan Conversion
steps.goal: Draft Notion payloads, Markdown files, or RAG index chunks.

steps.title: Hand Off
steps.goal: Summarize drafts, source metadata, and manual steps.
